title: Bounded condensed scalar multiplication commutes with scheme inverse image
statement: Let ell be prime and g: Z -> Y any morphism of schemes. For a bounded finite-subextension-valued continuous function a on Y, use the explicit scalar actions and the canonical regular-module comparison of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-qbar-coefficient-construction]. Conjugating the inverse image of scalar multiplication by a with this comparison gives scalar multiplication on Z by a composed with the underlying continuous map of g. No weakly etale or noetherian assumption is needed.

source.place: Section 4, finite-matrix refinement: presentation and geometric-fibre comparison after coefficient realization (steps 1--3)

proof.text: Precomposition along the first projection U times_Y Z -> U gives a map from bounded abelian presheaves on Y to the base-change direct image of bounded abelian presheaves on Z. The finite-subextension bound is preserved. Compose with the target sheafification unit and extend by the sheafification adjunction. This constructs the abelian sheaf morphism boundedPushforward used in the realization square; no ring-morphism construction or arbitrary existence witness is needed.

source.place: Section 4, finite-matrix refinement: presentation and geometric-fibre comparison after coefficient realization (steps 1--3)

proof.text: The resulting morphism intertwines the canonical realizations with condensedPushforwardHom. Apply the composite point and scheme adjunction and evaluate on each profinite S and each bounded test function. globalCoefficientIso_test makes both composites the sheafification unit applied to that test function pulled back through Z[S] to S. Naturality of the sheafification unit and the explicit pullbackComp comparison identify Y[S] times_Y Z with Z[S] and commute with the projections. The existing proved chartMate_homEquiv from [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-chart-scheme-naturality], accessed by a proof-only import all, identifies the adjoint of the composite coefficient mate. No duplicate mate lemma or separate profinite-point-coherence theorem is used. Section extensionality and injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence prove the square.

source.place: Section 4, finite-matrix refinement: presentation and geometric-fibre comparison after coefficient realization (steps 1--3)

proof.text: Pointwise multiplication by a followed by precomposition is precomposition followed by multiplication by a composed with g. Naturality and monoidality of the sheafification unit transport this equality to the coefficient sheaves.

source.place: Section 4, finite-matrix refinement: presentation and geometric-fibre comparison after coefficient realization (steps 1--3)

proof.text: Conjugate through the commuting realization square. The two components of extendScalarsIsoComapInv cancel by its naturality, and regularIsoOfIsIso has underlying morphism condensedPullbackHom. The resulting module endomorphism is exactly the scalar on Z. Empty Z gives the unique endomorphism of the zero coefficient object.
